On July 17, 2026, the Company completed the divestiture of its 20% ownership interest in Artmin to Lidya Madençilik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş (“Lidya Mines”), which owns the Hod Maden development project (the “Project”), for an uncapped 4.0% net smelter return royalty on 100% of the Project.
Accordingly, the Company does not expect Pillar Two to have a material adverse impact on its income tax provision for the 2026 year.

estimates.name: Royalty interests in mineral properties and related depletion
estimates.t: Royalty interests are depleted using the unit of production method over the estimated life of the related mineral property as royalty payments are recognized.

statements.t: Year-to-date results remain aligned with full-year 2026 production guidance of 450,000 to 535,000 gold equivalent ounces and the Company’s expectations of strong fourth quarter results.

At Puna, the Company continues to identify additional ore that supports potential mine life extension, resulting in resequencing that defers lower-cost production from stockpiled ore that was planned to be processed in 2026.

This decision, combined with higher royalty costs, persistent diesel price pressures and broader labor and input cost inflation, is expected to result in full-year AISC trending approximately 10% above the upper end of the Company’s 2026 guidance.

• Completed strategic repositioning to the Americas: On July 17, 2026, the Company closed the sale of its 20% ownership stake in the Hod Maden development project (the "Hod Maden Project") for an uncapped 4.0% net smelter return royalty ("NSR") on 100% of the Hod Maden Project.

• Accretive Acquisition of Roxmore Resources: On October 13, 2026, SSR Mining announced an agreement for the all-cash acquisition of Roxmore Resources and its multi-million-ounce Converse Gold Project adjacent to the Company’s Marigold Complex.
Earlier-stage exploration activity is also continuing across the Company’s more than 13,000-hectare land position in Nevada and at regional targets in Saskatchewan.

This includes completing our exit from Türkiye with the Çöpler and Hod Maden divestments, delivering an improved, multi-decade mine plan for Marigold, and announcing an agreement to acquire the Converse Project in Nevada to further bolster our U.S. platform.
Operationally, we remain on track for full-year production guidance with steady third quarter results ahead of a strong fourth quarter.
Although costs are trending approximately 10% above the top end of our original guidance ranges, we expect robust free cash flow into year-end.
